# Demant is a global hearing healthcare and audio technology group

In every aspect, from providing hearing care and delivering hearing aids to diagnostic equipment and
services to hearing care professionals and users all over the world, the Demant Group is active and
engaged.
* [ha-president-2026]
  
  ## Expansion of Demant’s Executive Leadership Team  
  
  Effective 1 June 2026, Bassel Rifai will join Demant as President of the Hearing Aids business
  area. As part of this change, Søren Nielsen will step out of his role as President of Hearing Aids
  to focus fully on his position as President & CEO of the Demant Group. Read more [here][34]
* [playsi-q1-2026]
  
  ## Interim Management Statement Q1 2026
  
  On 5 May, Demant released its [Interim Management Statement][35] for the first quarter of 2026.
  The Group delivered 6% organic revenue growth, driven by very strong organic growth of 9% in
  Hearing Aids fuelled by the leading AI-based hearing aids Oticon Zeal. You will find a link to
  the [recorded webcast][36] and the [presentation][37] here.
* [image-spot_oticon-medical-divestment]
  
  ## Demant completes divestment of Oticon Medical
  
  Demant has today completed the divestment of Oticon Medical to Impilo. The divestment allows us to
  further strengthen our commitment to delivering on our strategy by focusing on innovative
  diagnostic solutions, hearing aids technology and delivering professional, personalised care
  through our clinic network. [Read announcement][38]
* [oticon-zeal-launch]
  
  ## Oticon announces new hearing aid style
  
  Oticon Zeal™, the world's most discreet, complete hearing aid and completely new in-the-ear
  hearing aid style is the world’s first solution where users don’t need to compromise between
  in-the-ear discreetness and full functionality. Read the [announcement ][39]

# Tune in to life

Tune in to life portrays life inside Demant and how our products and services enable users to tune
in to the things that matter. In a cinematic journey into our world of hearing health,  we invite
viewers into our sound studios, our labs, our hearing care clinics and into the heart of our
production and distribution – and we see how teamwork across borders and departments forms an
indispensable foundation for our daily work.

# Important Update Regarding Eargo

For over a decade, Eargo has been dedicated to democratizing access to high-quality hearing aids and
care. Today, we write with a heavy heart to share some difficult news about the future of that
journey.

Our parent company, LXE Hearing, has begun a wind-down of its US operations. This decision follows
extensive efforts to restructure the business and pursue strategic transactions to maintain support
for our customers. Unfortunately, despite these efforts, we were unable to identify a viable path
forward and have made the difficult decision to wind down the US business.

You’re our valued customer and our priority right now is to handle this transition with the
transparency and respect you deserve. Here is what this means for you moving forward:
* **Your Hearing Aids and App:** Your hearing aids will continue to provide hearing amplification
  and core functionality. At this time, the Eargo mobile application will continue operating as
  normal. We are developing a long-term transition plan for our applications and support services
  and will provide additional information before any changes occur. Please ensure that we have your
  current email address so that you receive future updates.
* **Immediate Support:** Our customer service representatives will remain available for at least the
  next two months. They are equipped to process eligible refunds, handle troubleshooting, and assist
  with active warranties. During this period our support hours remain Mon - Fri 8 am to 8 pm CT, and
  Sat 8 am to 5 pm CT. You can reach us by emailing support@eargo.com or by phoning 1-855-690-9360.
* **Warranty Services:** We will continue processing warranty claims submitted within the next two
  months. We will provide additional information regarding warranty administration after that period
  as our transition plans develop.
* **Future Support and Services:** We are evaluating available options regarding future customer
  support, application functionality, and warranty administration. We will provide additional
  information as those plans develop which we expect to be in the next 60 days. At this time, we
  cannot guarantee the availability of any future support services beyond what is described in this
  notice.

We are incredibly grateful for the trust you placed in us and for your support in our mission over
the years. Thank you for your patience as our team works diligently to support you through this
transition.

Sincerely,

**The Eargo Team**

## FAQs

### App & Technology

Will the app continue working?

At this time, your mobile application will continue to operate normally to support your hearing
aids. We are currently developing a long-term transition plan for our applications and will ensure
we share additional information with you before any changes take place.

Can I still download the app?

The app is currently still available for download. However, please note that it will not be
available indefinitely. We are actively working on a long-term transition plan for our applications
and will be sure to notify you well in advance before download support stops.

Will future updates occur?

While we are working on a long-term transition plan for our software, the notice doesn't explicitly
state whether there will be any future software or firmware updates to fix bugs or maintain
compatibility with new phone operating systems.

### Support, Warranties, & Parts

Will customer support remain available?

Our customer service representatives will remain available through at least September 15th. They are
fully equipped to help you with troubleshooting, processing eligible refunds, and assisting with
active warranties. While we cannot guarantee support services beyond this two-month window, we are
actively evaluating our options and will update you as plans develop.

Will LXE continue honoring warranties?

We will continue to process warranty claims submitted through September, 15th. We are currently
developing plans for how warranties will be administered after this period and will provide you with
more information as those plans take shape.

What happens if I need replacement parts?

If you need replacement parts (such as tips, domes, or wax guards), please reach out to our customer
service team. During this transition period, our team will do our absolute best to accommodate your
requests, but service may be limited based on our available inventory and resources.

### Communication

Where can I receive future announcements?

All future updates and important information regarding our transition plans will be sent directly to
your email. Please take a moment to ensure we have your current email address on file so you don't
miss any updates. You can update your e-mail on file either through our App or by reaching out to
Customer Service.

  information as those plans develop which we expect to be in the next 60 days. At this time, we

  notice.

the years. Thank you for your patience as our team works diligently to support you through this
transition.

Will the app continue working?

aids. We are currently developing a long-term transition plan for our applications and will ensure
we share additional information with you before any changes take place.

Can I still download the app?

available indefinitely. We are actively working on a long-term transition plan for our applications
and will be sure to notify you well in advance before download support stops.

Will future updates occur?

state whether there will be any future software or firmware updates to fix bugs or maintain
compatibility with new phone operating systems.

actively evaluating our options and will update you as plans develop.

We will continue to process warranty claims submitted through September, 15th. We are currently
developing plans for how warranties will be administered after this period and will provide you with
more information as those plans take shape.

What happens if I need replacement parts?

If you need replacement parts (such as tips, domes, or wax guards), please reach out to our customer
service team. During this transition period, our team will do our absolute best to accommodate your
requests, but service may be limited based on our available inventory and resources.

### Communication

Where can I receive future announcements?

All future updates and important information regarding our transition plans will be sent directly to
your email. Please take a moment to ensure we have your current email address on file so you don't
miss any updates. You can update your e-mail on file either through our App or by reaching out to
Customer Service.

Hearing Solutions with HearUSA

## Hearing Care Is Available With or Without Insurance.

You don't need hearing aid insurance coverage to start hearing better. HearUSA offers a **variety of
hearing solutions and flexible payment options** to help make hearing care more accessible.

During your appointment, we'll check your hearing, discuss your lifestyle needs, and recommend
solutions that fit both your hearing goals and your budget.

[
Claim my free hearing aid trial
][13]

## Why HearUSA?

[Hearing Aid Icon HearUSA]

### Experience life like the good old days. The HearUSA way.

Try on various hearing aids during your appointment and our professionals will identify the best
option for you. Begin the journey of simply excellent hearing and enjoy reconnecting with friends,
family and the world around you - **all with a brand recognized as America’s Best Retailer, three
years running**.
[
][14]
[Insurance Icon HearUSA]

### Maximize your insurance benefits. Our experts will discover and apply all the savings you're
### entitled to.

Our experts will find **every discount possible** and apply them to your purchase. We work with
100's of insurances and we will help uncover potential savings so that you make the most of your
valuable insurance benefits.



[
][15]
[Goal Icon HearUSA]

### Hear better today. Custom tailored hearing solution. Without the wait.

Skip the wait and enjoy same day hearing aid fittings. Book a **complimentary hearing screening**
and enjoy simply excellent hearing with your new hearing aids all in the same day! Take them for a
**60 day test trial** and if you do not love them simply return them for a full refund.
[
][16]

## HearUSA is completely different than any other provider.

Michelle’s journey to better hearing didn’t happen overnight. After years of living without hearing
aids, she finally found a hearing care provider she could trust at HearUSA.

You don't need hearing aid insurance coverage to start hearing better. HearUSA offers a **variety of
hearing solutions and flexible payment options** to help make hearing care more accessible.

[Hearing Aid Icon HearUSA]

### Experience life like the good old days. The HearUSA way.

Try on various hearing aids during your appointment and our professionals will identify the best
option for you. Begin the journey of simply excellent hearing and enjoy reconnecting with friends,
family and the world around you - **all with a brand recognized as America’s Best Retailer, three
years running**.

100's of insurances and we will help uncover potential savings so that you make the most of your
valuable insurance benefits.

and enjoy simply excellent hearing with your new hearing aids all in the same day! Take them for a
**60 day test trial** and if you do not love them simply return them for a full refund.
[
][16]

# **Amplihear**

### **Rediscover the Joy of Hearing**

Amplihear is an innovative and affordable solution designed to enhance your hearing experience. It
combines cutting-edge technology with user-friendly features to provide clear and crisp sound
quality without the need for expensive hearing tests or complicated setups.

### **Unrivaled Sound Excellence**

Amplihear delivers exceptional audio clarity, allowing you to enjoy conversations and sounds with
remarkable precision.

### **Convenient Wireless Charging**

Say goodbye to the hassle of replacing batteries. Amplihear features wireless charging capabilities
for effortless power replenishment.

### **Impressive 20-Hour Battery Life**

With a long-lasting battery, you can confidently use your Amplihear throughout the day without
interruptions.

### **No Need for Hearing Tests**

Amplihear eliminates the need for time-consuming and potentially costly hearing tests, making it
accessible to a wider range of users.

### **Affordability**

Amplihear offers high-quality hearing assistance at a fraction of the cost of traditional hearing
aids, making it an economical choice for those seeking improved hearing.

## **How Amplihear Works**

Amplihear utilizes advanced audio technology to amplify and enhance sounds in your environment. Its
sophisticated design allows for:
1. **Sound Amplification**: The device captures ambient sounds and conversations, amplifying them to
   a comfortable level for the user.
2. **Noise Reduction**: Amplihear employs smart algorithms to filter out background noise, focusing

## About Audiology KZN

### Audiology KZN is a leading audiology clinic based in Hilton, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.

Specialising in newborn hearing screening, pediatric hearing tests, comprehensive hearing
assessments, hearing aid fittings, and tinnitus management. The clinic is dedicated to improving the
hearing health of each patient.
* Compassionate Approach
* Commitment to Excellence
* Transforming Lives Through Better Hearing

## Comprehensive Audiology Services

## Newborn Hearing Screening

Newborn hearing screening in audiology clinics detects hearing issues in infants shortly after birth
through simple tests, enabling early intervention and support for timely identification and
management of any impairments.

[mjrif-kw5zw.jpg]
[Pediatric-hearing.jpg]

## Pediatric Hearing

Pediatric hearing screening  involves tests to check children’s hearing. These screenings help
detect any hearing issues early for better support in speech and language development. 

## Hearing Aid Fittings

Our expert audiologists specialize in customizing and fitting hearing aids to suit your unique
hearing needs. We offer a wide range of advanced hearing aids from leading brands to ensure optimal
comfort and performance.

[zipwp-image-1e7e9PorPVU.jpeg]
[zipwp-image-4021779.jpeg]

## Hearing Assessments

Our hearing assessments are conducted by skilled audiologists to evaluate the extent of your hearing
loss. We use advanced testing methods to accurately diagnose your condition and develop an
appropriate treatment plan.

## Tinnitus Management

If you’re experiencing tinnitus, our experienced audiologists can help you effectively manage and
reduce the impact of this condition on your daily life. We offer a range of tinnitus management
strategies tailored to your individual needs

[tinnitus.jpg]

Moosa Meeran

Moosa Meeran

Moosa is a highly skilled audiologist dedicated to improving the hearing health of his patients.
With years of experience and a passion for helping others, he brings a compassionate approach to
every aspect of audiology care.

He specialises in newborn hearing screening, as well as pediatric and adult hearing
assessments. Moosa values personalized treatment plans and utilizes cutting-edge technology to
ensure optimal hearing outcomes for each individual.

Qualifications

### Education & Qualifications
* BSc (Hons) Audiology. University of Cape Town (2007).
* Bachelor of Social Science – Psychology. University of Natal (2002).
* Vestibular Assessment and Rehabilitation Therapy. University of Cape Town (2012).
* Hi Hopes Training. WITS (2013).

### Experience
* Over 15 years of clinical experience in working with hearing loss with both Adults and Children.

### Certification
* HPCSA registered.
* SAAA member.

## Take a Step Towards Better Hearing

Book an appointment with our skilled audiologist to start your journey to improved hearing.
[ Book an appointment ][9]

proclaimed to be even better than the one that had been lost! I have no reservations in recommending
Moosa Meeran. I wish him all the very best. Thank you

cost-effective hearing aids for our partners.

[12 MONTHES WARRANTY]

### 12 Months Warranty

AZ Hearing offer a standard 12-month factory warranty to partners. We are confident with the
components used in our products.

### Responsible After-Sales

We have solved distributors’ headaches with returns/repair/refurbishment for years. You could send
defective hearing devices in bulk and we will take care of them.

[100% QUALITY INSPECTION]

### 100% Quality Inspection

Since product quality is essential to our business, all products undergo 3 rounds of differing
quality checks. We only deliver products that have passed our stringent internal inspection.

### Top Imported Components

Most of our hearing aids use chips from industrial leading brands which will ensure the best
performance and high quality products.

[professional oem/odm servicer]

### Professional OEM/ODM Support

We have been offering our partners with professional labeling services since 2015. From the
engraving on hearing aids body to customized packaging, we are ready to provide these services.

### Claro -Revolutionary Rechargeable Hearing Aids
*  Automatic shutdown when charging
* LED indicator of charging status
* 3 listening programs,Telecoil available
* 4 Channel digital chip WDRC Multi Memories Amplifier

[ Get Claro Sample Now! ][47]

### Ask Us Anything

Could working with AZ Hearing expand my business?
Yes, we always try to help our partners gain a bigger market share. Our Puro helped a few
distributors in the States achieve a huge breakthrough in e-commerce, allowing them to sell 5000
units a month. AZ Hearing does not just supply hearing aid products, we are ready and willing to
discuss business solutions with you.
Should I consider purchasing hearing aids from AZ Hearing?

Definitely. There are numbers of hearing aid suppliers in China, we may not be the best, but we’re
certainly trustworthy.
AZ Hearing is a professional manufacturers and factory of hearing aids, sound amplifiers and
faceplate in China, we have over 6 years of OEM/ODM experience.
As a medical device, hearing aid is closely related to the user’s health and life, and quality is
especially important. Quality is a key part enriches us with confidence. We share information and do
business with our partners openly and honestly. 

What are the modes of transport?

Hearing aids are relatively small in size, light in weight and high in added value, and express
delivery is the preferred method for most buyers, with express carriers including DHL, UPS, FedEx,
TNT and others. The shipping fee for the sample is around $35$-60$ based on global zones for your
reference.
If you have set up your own express account, we could ship with your account if you wish. 

What is the future of hearing aid industry?

Good question, thank you for asking it. Hearing aid manufacturing in China has developed rapidly in
the last decade or so. The market need for hearing aids is increasing with population ageing and
awareness of hearing care. From the demand side, hearing aids market is thriving.

Hearing aid technology is also evolving, for instance, the application of Bluetooth, apps and
rechargeability. We think hearing aids will become an increasingly important wearable device that
can assist users during daily life.

The involvement of tech companies like Bose, Nuhera & Eargo in recent years indicates that more and
more companies are bullish on hearing aid market.

We’re looking forward to more changes in hearing aids market and will continue to offer
cost-effective hearing aids for our partners. 

How do you ensure the quality of the product?

First of all, our factory follows ISO regulations and has a strict quality inspection process to
ensure quality. IQC is performed after raw materials are obtained, FQC is performed when production
is completed, and OQC is performed after packaging.

We also implement the CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) system to improve quality. If there
are any problems occur during the production, the process will be suspended and we will provide
feedback on the problem. Preventive actions will also be taken to stop similar problems happen in
the future. 

How does AZ Hearing provide maintenance services?

**We pride ourselves on listening first, adapting to patient needs, and guiding each patient on

## We focus on creating a positive and integrative healthcare experience.

**Hearing loss journeys are as individual as the people experiencing them, and solutions are not
one-size-fits all. **

Marie Vetter Au.D’s early work studying and practicing audiology showed her how often patients feel
like they’re being churned through a machine. She bought Chicago Hearing Services in 2016 to create
a new kind of place for hearing loss treatment. A place where appointments are for conversations,
not transactions. A place where you never feel rushed into a decision. A place that supports you for
your entire hearing loss journey — whether you need hearing aids or not.

[Meet Our Team][71]

 

***Did you know?*** We also care for patients in **Arlington Heights** and surrounding suburbs
through our sister clinic, **Northwest Speech and Hearing Center**. Same standard of care, different
location.
[Visit Northwest Speech and Hearing Center's website][72]

## What makes Chicago Hearing Services different

### Better Hearing Experience

We’ve built an environment where all patients can feel comfortable, confident, and in control of
their hearing care journey.

### Maintaining a Standard of Excellence

Our Doctors of Audiology’s expertise and standard of excellence help patients regain and live a
happy, healthy, active lifestyle.

### Customized Hearing Wellness Plans

No two hearing loss journeys are the same. We listen to every patient’s story and build an
individualized hearing wellness plan that suits their needs, goals, and lifestyle.

## We focus on creating a positive and integrative healthcare experience.

**Hearing loss journeys are as individual as the people experiencing them, and solutions are not
one-size-fits all. **

Marie Vetter Au.D’s early work studying and practicing audiology showed her how often patients feel
like they’re being churned through a machine. She bought Chicago Hearing Services in 2016 to create
a new kind of place for hearing loss treatment. A place where appointments are for conversations,
not transactions. A place where you never feel rushed into a decision. A place that supports you for
your entire hearing loss journey — whether you need hearing aids or not.

[Meet Our Team][71]

 

***Did you know?*** We also care for patients in **Arlington Heights** and surrounding suburbs
through our sister clinic, **Northwest Speech and Hearing Center**. Same standard of care, different
location.

# Welcome to Connecticut ENT Allergy & Sinus

[CT ENT Banner]

Connecticut ENT Allergy & Sinus delivers expert ear, nose, throat, and head and neck medical and
surgical care for adults and children from our Waterbury, Southbury, and Southington, CT offices.
Our board-certified doctors and specialists treat the full spectrum of ENT conditions, including
allergy and sinus conditions, ear infections, hearing and balance disorders, snoring and sleep
apnea, head, neck, and thyroid masses, speech and swallowing difficulties, and pediatric ENT
evaluation and management. We are committed to exceptional, patient-centered care where our
providers and staff work together to help you understand your condition and get on the path to
better health faster.

Learn about our **[services][40]** below or contact us at either of our Waterbury offices at (203)
578-4630 or (203) 574-3777 [**to schedule an appointment**][41]**.**

## Our ENT Services

Connecticut ENT Allergy & Sinus offers a full spectrum of ear, nose, and throat care, from allergy
treatment and hearing loss management to balloon sinuplasty, sleep apnea treatment, and head and
neck surgery. Our board-certified physicians bring expertise across both common and complex ENT
conditions for patients of all ages. Whatever you are facing, our team has the expertise and
experience to help you hear, breathe, and feel better.

# DUNGARVAN AUDIOLOGY & HEARING AID CLINIC Ltd.

Home: Welcome

## Welcome to Dungarvan Audiology, your trusted partner in comprehensive hearing care. I offer a
## wide range of services to meet all your audiology needs, from diagnostic hearing assessments to
## custom ear moulds. My goal is to ensure you receive the highest quality care.

Home: Text

## SERVICES PROVIDED

Care Tailored to You

[equipment_edited.jpg]

### EXAMINATION

Diagnostic Hearing assessments for adults and children

Pre-employment tests

Diagnostic Hearing Assessments for Adults and Children

At Dungarvan Audiology, I provide thorough diagnostic hearing assessments for both adults and
children. Using state-of-the-art equipment, I conduct a variety of tests, including pure-tone
audiometry, speech audiometry, and tympanometry. Early detection and intervention are key to
managing hearing loss effectively. Schedule your hearing assessment today to ensure optimal hearing
health for you and your family.


Pre-Employment Hearing Tests

Ensure you meet the auditory requirements for your job with my pre-employment hearing tests. I offer
comprehensive hearing screenings, including pure-tone audiometry and speech audiometry, to help you
secure your position and maintain workplace safety. Regular monitoring in compliance with OSHA
guidelines is also available to protect your hearing health in noisy environments.

### HEARING AIDS

PRSI Grants Available

Demo hearing aids available to trial


PRSI Grants Available

Take advantage of the PRSI grants available for hearing aids at Dungarvan Audiology. I will guide
you through the application process to ensure you receive the financial assistance you need.
Discover the latest in hearing aid technology and improve your quality of life with affordable
solutions.


Demo Hearing Aids Available to Trial

Experience the benefits of better hearing first hand with my demo hearing aids. At Dungarvan
Audiology, I offer a range of hearing aids available for trial, allowing you to find the perfect fit
for your lifestyle. Book your trial today and hear the difference.


Making sure that you benefit from the latest medical advances is extremely important. That is why
Dungarvan Audiology and Hearing Aid Clinic provides innovative treatments to help you live active
and productive lives. Contact the practice to schedule your next appointment.

[signia pic_edited.jpg]
[Putting on Goggles_edited.jpg]

### EAR MOULDS

Custom made for musicians, noise protection and swimming

Protect your ears with custom-made ear moulds from Dungarvan Audiology. Whether you're a musician
needing high-fidelity earplugs, require noise protection in loud environments, or need swim plugs to
prevent water from entering your ears, my custom solutions provide the perfect fit and maximum
comfort. Contact me to learn more about bespoke ear moulds.

### TINNITUS MANAGEMENT

Tailored to your individual needs



Managing tinnitus can be challenging, but at Dungarvan Audiology, I offer personalised tinnitus
management plans tailored to your specific needs. Using a combination of therapies,
including counselling, and hearing aids, I help reduce the impact of tinnitus on your daily life.
Schedule a consultation today to find relief from tinnitus.

Nothing matters to Dungarvan Audiology and Hearing Aid Clinic more than the health of you and your
loved ones. Get in touch today to book a suitable time or to find out more.

[otoscopy pic_edited.jpg]
[earimageweb_edited.jpg]

### EAR WAX REMOVAL

Micro suction

Say goodbye to ear wax buildup with my safe and effective micro suction ear wax removal service. I
use gentle micro suction technology to remove excess ear wax quickly and painlessly, ensuring your
ears stay clear and your hearing remains sharp. Book your ear wax removal appointment today.

Home: Services

## ABOUT

Providing Care since 2007

Maria Foley B.A.A.T. M.I.A.A. M.I.S.H.A.A. is  Clinical Audiologist and an independent Hearing Aid
provider with comprehensive experience in Diagnostic Hearing Assessment for adults and paediatrics,
Hearing Aid Fitting, Ear wax removal (micro suction) and Tinnitus Management. 

 

Maria Qualified as an Audiologist in 2007 from The Royal Victoria Hospital, Belfast. Between 2007
and 2023 Maria worked as a Senior Clinical Audiologist in the public sector in the South East of
Ireland. 

 

While working in the public sector, Maria gained extensive experience in Diagnostic Hearing
Assessment & Hearing Aid Fitting in community care and hospital settings.

# Welcome to EHDI-PALS

EHDI-PALS is a web-based searchable national directory. It helps families, healthcare professionals,
and state public health organizations to find pediatric audiology expertise for children ages birth
to five. The website provides information about childhood hearing to support families and
professionals through the process of screening, diagnosis, and intervention.

This site links you to information, resources, and services for children with hearing loss. At the
heart of EHDI-PALS is a national web-based directory of facilities that offer pediatric audiology
services to young children who are younger than five years of age.

This website contains great resources for parents and professionals.
[Learn More][10] about childhood hearing loss, hearing testing, early intervention and family
support-including important questions parents may ask as they are going through the EHDI process.

Find [Other Helpful Websites][11], including national and state parent support organizations and
other related resources.

You can also find out more about the [EHDI-PALS Advisory Group][12].

To learn more about childhood hearing loss or if you need help throughout the screening, diagnosis
and early intervention process, [contact your state Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
Coordinator][13] to assist you.

## Compassionate Care

For Your Child’s Unique Needs

# ENT for Children Is Dedicated to Serving Pediatric Patients

Childhood is filled with excitement, and our team strives to make sure our patients can enjoy it to
the fullest. We provide compassionate and comprehensive care for ENT, audiology and allergy concerns
that will guide your youngest family members to a healthy and fulfilling future.

Pediatric patients have unique needs that we are dedicated to meeting. Schedule a consultation with
ENT for Children’s expert and empathetic providers to get started.

[ About Us ][148]
[ Meet Our Team ][149]
[ Request Appointment ][150]

## Pediatric ENT

We provide treatment to make sure ENT symptoms do not detract from the wonders of childhood.

[FIND CARE][151]

## Pediatric Audiology

We are dedicated to ensuring our patients can hear the sounds that make their youth special.

[NURTURE BETTER HEARING][152]

## Pediatric Allergy

Every child has specific allergy triggers, which is why our team customizes care to each patient.

[EXPLORE TREATMENTS][153]

## Compassionate Care

# ENT for Children Is Dedicated to Serving Pediatric Patients

Childhood is filled with excitement, and our team strives to make sure our patients can enjoy it to
the fullest. We provide compassionate and comprehensive care for ENT, audiology and allergy concerns
that will guide your youngest family members to a healthy and fulfilling future.

Pediatric patients have unique needs that we are dedicated to meeting. Schedule a consultation with
ENT for Children’s expert and empathetic providers to get started.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

επιτυχία των ακουολογικών υπηρεσιών. Οι ολοκληρωμένες αξιολογήσεις μας και οι εξατομικευμένες λύσεις
ακοής σας εγγυώνται το καλύτερο δυνατό αποτέλεσμα.
Τα Ακουολογικά Κέντρα Ευθυμιάδης έχουν απλωθεί παγκύπρια για να είναι πιο κοντά σας, παρέχοντας
ολοκληρωμένη ακουστική φροντίδα σε όλο το νησί, με επτά κλινικές σε Λευκωσία, Λατσιά, Έγκωμη,
Λάρνακα, Λεμεσό, Πάφο και Αστρομερίτη καθώς επίσης και κατ’οίκον επισκέψεις σε άτομα με δυσκολία
κίνησης. Κάθε κλινική διατηρεί υψηλά επαγγελματικά πρότυπα και παρέχει τεχνική υποστήριξη και
εξατομικευμένη φροντίδα εφ' όρου ζωής.

## The Link Between Hearing and Health

Hearing health is a critical component of your overall well-being, and untreated hearing loss can
lead to a cascade of physical, emotional, and cognitive challenges. Studies show that hearing loss
is linked to an increased risk of social isolation, depression, and even cognitive decline. It can
also affect balance, increasing the likelihood of falls.

At Grand Strand Audiology, we view hearing care as an integral part of a healthy lifestyle. We
believe that you can improve your communication, maintain strong relationships, and enjoy a higher
quality of life by addressing hearing issues promptly. Don’t let hearing loss hold you back; invest
in your health today.

## Featured Technology

Our clinic is proud to offer the latest advancements in hearing technology. From state-of-the-art
diagnostic equipment to the newest hearing aid models, we’re committed to providing solutions that
meet your needs. We partner with trusted brands like Oticon, Signia, and Phonak to bring you devices
with exceptional performance and reliability.

We also provide assistive listening devices and custom hearing protection to improve your experience
in every environment. Technology evolves quickly, and we stay at the forefront to ensure you benefit
from the best options available. When it comes to your hearing, you deserve nothing but the best.

## Why Choose Us

**Choosing the right audiology practice makes all the difference in your hearing care journey.**

### Personalized Care

At Grand Strand Audiology, we pride ourselves on delivering personalized care without manufacturer
bias. You can trust us for recommendations that truly align with your needs.

### Advanced Expertise

Our expertise extends to advanced audiology practices, such as real-ear measurements and speech
mapping, which guarantee precise and effective solutions.

### Family Friendly

At Harley Street Hearing, we specialise in all aspects of hearing to enhance your communication in
everyday life. We provide hearing diagnosis, solutions for your individual hearing needs, as well as
luxury custom-made protection for all types of lifestyle choices.

to the UK entertainment industry. Our team of highly qualified clinical audiologists specialise in
all areas of hearing care, from hearing tests and ear wax removal to custom-made hearing protection,

Musicians, the Musicians’ Union (MU), and The Independent Society of Musicians (ISM), we provide
affordable access to the [Musicians’ Hearing Health Scheme][95] for musicians across the UK.

### Ask Us Anything

Could working with AZ Hearing expand my business?
Yes, we always try to help our partners gain a bigger market share. Our Puro helped a few
distributors in the States achieve a huge breakthrough in e-commerce, allowing them to sell 5000
units a month. AZ Hearing does not just supply hearing aid products, we are ready and willing to
discuss business solutions with you.
Should I consider purchasing hearing aids from AZ Hearing?

Definitely. There are numbers of hearing aid suppliers in China, we may not be the best, but we’re
certainly trustworthy.
AZ Hearing is a professional manufacturers and factory of hearing aids, sound amplifiers and
faceplate in China, we have over 6 years of OEM/ODM experience.
As a medical device, hearing aid is closely related to the user’s health and life, and quality is
especially important. Quality is a key part enriches us with confidence. We share information and do
business with our partners openly and honestly. 

What are the modes of transport?

Hearing aids are relatively small in size, light in weight and high in added value, and express
delivery is the preferred method for most buyers, with express carriers including DHL, UPS, FedEx,
TNT and others. The shipping fee for the sample is around $35$-60$ based on global zones for your
reference.
If you have set up your own express account, we could ship with your account if you wish. 

What is the future of hearing aid industry?

Good question, thank you for asking it. Hearing aid manufacturing in China has developed rapidly in
the last decade or so. The market need for hearing aids is increasing with population ageing and
awareness of hearing care. From the demand side, hearing aids market is thriving.

Hearing aid technology is also evolving, for instance, the application of Bluetooth, apps and
rechargeability. We think hearing aids will become an increasingly important wearable device that
can assist users during daily life.

The involvement of tech companies like Bose, Nuhera & Eargo in recent years indicates that more and
more companies are bullish on hearing aid market.

We’re looking forward to more changes in hearing aids market and will continue to offer
cost-effective hearing aids for our partners. 

How do you ensure the quality of the product?

First of all, our factory follows ISO regulations and has a strict quality inspection process to
ensure quality. IQC is performed after raw materials are obtained, FQC is performed when production
is completed, and OQC is performed after packaging.

We also implement the CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) system to improve quality. If there
are any problems occur during the production, the process will be suspended and we will provide
feedback on the problem. Preventive actions will also be taken to stop similar problems happen in
the future. 

How does AZ Hearing provide maintenance services?

If you could repair locally, we can send components to you; or you can send defective hearing aids
back to China so we could repair/refurbish them. Chin

Could working with AZ Hearing expand my business?
Yes, we always try to help our partners gain a bigger market share. Our Puro helped a few

Should I consider purchasing hearing aids from AZ Hearing?

Definitely. There are numbers of hearing aid suppliers in China, we may not be the best, but we’re
certainly trustworthy.
AZ Hearing is a professional manufacturers and factory of hearing aids, sound amplifiers and
faceplate in China, we have over 6 years of OEM/ODM experience.
As a medical device, hearing aid is closely related to the user’s health and life, and quality is
especially important. Quality is a key part enriches us with confidence. We share information and do
business with our partners openly and honestly. 

What are the modes of transport?

Hearing aids are relatively small in size, light in weight and high in added value, and express
delivery is the preferred method for most buyers, with express carriers including DHL, UPS, FedEx,
TNT and others. The shipping fee for the sample is around $35$-60$ based on global zones for your
reference.
If you have set up your own express account, we could ship with your account if you wish. 

What is the future of hearing aid industry?

Good question, thank you for asking it. Hearing aid manufacturing in China has developed rapidly in
the last decade or so. The market need for hearing aids is increasing with population ageing and
awareness of hearing care. From the demand side, hearing aids market is thriving.

Hearing aid technology is also evolving, for instance, the application of Bluetooth, apps and
rechargeability. We think hearing aids will become an increasingly important wearable device that
can assist users during daily life.

The involvement of tech companies like Bose, Nuhera & Eargo in recent years indicates that more and
more companies are bullish on hearing aid market.

We’re looking forward to more changes in hearing aids market and will continue to offer
cost-effective hearing aids for our partners. 

How do you ensure the quality of the product?

First of all, our factory follows ISO regulations and has a strict quality inspection process to
ensure quality. IQC is performed after raw materials are obtained, FQC is performed when production
is completed, and OQC is performed after packaging.

We also implement the CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) system to improve quality. If there
are any problems occur during the production, the process will be suspended and we will provide
feedback on the problem. Preventive actions will also be taken to stop similar problems happen in
the future. 

How does AZ Hearing provide maintenance services?

## **Welcome to Our Hearing Center,
## Aspire Audiology and Hearing!**

If you’re looking for a modern hearing center and innovative technology in Nashville, TN, you’ve
come to the right place. Hearing treatment is an investment in your current and future health.
[
Read Our Reviews
][34]
[Image]

### **Experience Advanced Hearing Solutions with Aspire Audiology**

At Aspire Audiology and Hearing, we’re excited to work with all the device manufacturers and major
insurance companies to provide you with advanced, state-of-the-art technology and comprehensive,
personalized care.

Although healthy hearing is important, we understand that it is a means to an end. Whether you’re
meeting up with friends, having an important meeting at work, or going to see your favorite band,
we’re confident we can help you get back to being the best version of yourself.

#### Hearing Tests

## **Hearing Tests at
## Aspire Audiology**

The earlier you treat a hearing loss, the more successful you will be in fighting it. And the first
step in any journey toward better hearing is with a hearing test. We use the best technology and
specialty care to measure exactly how well you can hear at various frequencies, as well as your
ability to understand speech.

[
Schedule Your Hearing Test Today!
][35]
[Image]

### Consultation

We will discuss your medical history to help identify any potential underlying causes of your
hearing loss.

[Image]

### Ear Examination

We conduct a thorough hearing evaluation to determine the extent of your hearing loss and assess
your overall hearing health.

[Image]

### Tests

We offer a range of tests to evaluate your hearing. These include pure-tone audiometry to measure
how you hear different sounds, speech recognition to assess your ability to understand spoken words,
and tympanometry to check for fluid or issues in the middle ear. These tests help us identify the
best treatment for your hearing needs

[Image]

### Review of Audiogram

The test results will be plotted on an audiogram, which provides a visual representation of your
hearing abilities. We will then review the findings with you and discuss the next steps for your
care

[Image]

## **Services**

### Va Services

Are you a veteran concerned about your hearing? You're not alone. Approximately one million veterans
receive hearing loss disability compensation annually.

[
][36]
[
Learn More
][37]

### Hearing Aid Repair

Hearing aids consist of sensitive electronic technology, small microphones, speakers, and tubing.
These tiny components can be filled with wax or moisture and fail from time to time.

[
][38]
[
Learn More
][39]

### Tinnitus

Tinnitus is a common condition affecting around 50 million Americans. Many people describe it as a
hissing, roaring, whooshing or buzzing noise. It can be intermittent or chronic, and is not a
disease itself, but a sign of an underlying medical condition.

[
][40]
[
Learn More
][41]

### Custom Hearing Protection

There are many pleasant sounds that we hear every day at safe levels that will not harm our hearing.
Some sounds however, can be damaging if they're too loud— even for a short period of time— or if
they're long-lasting, even if they're not as loud. These sounds can cause injury to part of the
inner ear and result in permanent loss of hearing.

[
][42]

Learn More
][43]

### **Experience Advanced Hearing Solutions with Aspire Audiology**

At Aspire Audiology and Hearing, we’re excited to work with all the device manufacturers and major
insurance companies to provide you with advanced, state-of-the-art technology and comprehensive,
personalized care.

Although healthy hearing is important, we understand that it is a means to an end. Whether you’re
meeting up with friends, having an important meeting at work, or going to see your favorite band,
we’re confident we can help you get back to being the best version of yourself.

#### Hearing Tests

## **Hearing Tests at
## Aspire Audiology**

The earlier you treat a hearing loss, the more successful you will be in fighting it. And the first
step in any journey toward better hearing is with a hearing test. We use the best technology and
specialty care to measure exactly how well you can hear at various frequencies, as well as your
ability to understand speech.

[
Schedule Your Hearing Test Today!
][35]
[Image]

### Consultation

We will discuss your medical history to help identify any potential underlying causes of your
hearing loss.

[Image]

### Ear Examination

We conduct a thorough hearing evaluation to determine the extent of your hearing loss and assess
your overall hearing health.

[Image]

### Tests

We offer a range of tests to evaluate your hearing. These include pure-tone audiometry to measure
how you hear different sounds, speech recognition to assess your ability to understand spoken words,
and tympanometry to check for fluid or issues in the middle ear. These tests help us identify the
best treatment for your hearing needs

[Image]

### Review of Audiogram

The test results will be plotted on an audiogram, which provides a visual representation of your
hearing abilities. We will then review the findings with you and discuss the next steps for your
care

[Image]

## **Services**

### Va Services

Are you a veteran concerned about your hearing? You're not alone. Approximately one million veterans
receive hearing loss disability compensation annually.

Learn More

### Hearing Aid Repair

Hearing aids consist of sensitive electronic technology, small microphones, speakers, and tubing.
These tiny components can be filled with wax or moisture and fail from time to time.

[
][38]
[
Learn More
][39]

### Tinnitus

Tinnitus is a common condition affecting around 50 million Americans. Many people describe it as a
hissing, roaring, whooshing or buzzing noise. It can be intermittent or chronic, and is not a
disease itself, but a sign of an underlying medical condition.

[
][40]
[
Learn More
][41]

### Custom Hearing Protection

There are many pleasant sounds that we hear every day at safe levels that will not harm our hearing.
Some sounds however, can be damaging if they're too loud— even for a short period of time— or if
they're long-lasting, even if they're not as loud. These sounds can cause injury to part of the
inner ear and result in permanent loss of hearing.

# Online Hearing Test and Audiogram Printout

This website offers you one of the easiest, fastest, and best hearing test on the Internet. More
than anything else, this one is also the most private that exists. We won't ask you to submit your
email address or create an account before accessing your results. Your personal hearing data will
not be used or shared with anyone else.


> Although these test files have been carefully designed, this website is not a substitute for a
> proper hearing test. You are encouraged to consult an audiologist as soon as you seriously feel
> concerned about a possible hearing loss. Beware, some of the audio tests tones can be damaging
> (excessively loud) if used improperly. You will be safe though by following the sound level
> calibration procedure and always starting by playing the quieter files first.

The next three sections take you through the actual hearing test. The rest of the page will give you
information about hearing loss, audiograms, and how to get the most reliable results out of this
page's hearing test.

# 1. **Calibrate** *your sound levels*

────────────────
Calibration     
File            
────────────────

Using headphones, listen to the calibration audio file. Then, without your headphones on, rub your
hands together closely in front of your nose, quickly and firmly, and try producing the same sound.

> If you have trouble hearing the sound of your hands rubbing, the test is completed before it has
> even begun: you likely suffer from a **severe** hearing loss. If you are wearing hearing aids, you
> can put them on now, and use this test to check if they are working correctly.

Adjust your computer's volume so that both levels match: the calibration file through your
headphones, and your hands rubbing, without headphones. Once matched, do not change your levels
anymore during the rest of the hearing test.

# 2. **Listen** *to the individual test files*

In a silent environment, starting from the top row, move down until you hear a tone. Do this for
each column.

> Always start with files on top of the table. The bottom files are for severe hearing losses, and
> will play very loudly for a normal hearing person!

Stop with the file whose tone becomes just audible - not the file above or below - before switching
to the next column.


Test Both Ears  Left Ear Only  Right Ear Only

# 3. **Review** *your personal audiogram*


Your personal hearing thresholds should now appear on the audiogram below. Ideally, the markers
should be located on the top of the graph, around the zero range.

[audiogram grid]
Overlay  Clear Markers  Print - Save - Bookmark


This graph is similar to what your audiologist's system would produce during a hearing test, and
plots the softest sounds you can hear across the different frequencies tested. Ideally, the six
markers should be located on the top of the graph, around the zero range. The next section explains
the audiogram in detail.

Click the 'Overlay' button to add information on top of your audiogram.

> The first overlay outlines the area related to conversational speech. It is in the shape of a
> banana and is often referred to as the “speech banana.” Vowels are located on the left side of the
> banana (the green area), and consonants are to the right (the blue area). Remember, all the sounds
> located above your individual hearing thresholds will be inaudible to you. If your personal
> markers are located inside (or worse, below) the speech banana, it means that your hearing will be
> missing part of the conversation, requiring your brain to compensate for this deficiency, by
> guessing words, for example.
> 
> The second overlay depicts some familiar sounds of our everyday life, such as rustling leaves,
> birds chirping, water dripping and other common sounds.

If you have mastered this hearing test and want to achieve a higher precision, try the alternate
test which adds in-between frequencies and hearing levels. To keep the sound table small, the
alternate test has been split in two frequency ranges. Make your choice below, proceed to section 2,
then check your audiogram again.


Alt Low [250-1500Hz]  Alt High [1500-8000Hz] Back to Original Test

(the horizontal lines). These are expressed in deciBels Hearing Level (dBHL). dBHL are not absolute
loudness levels but represent a difference between your hearing and the average "normal" hearing.

frequencies, not strictly at 0 dBHL. The loudness scale goes from very soft sounds on top (-5 dBHL)
to loud sounds at the bottom (80 dBHL).

As you perform this hearing test, markers will be set on the audiogram, and will correspond to your
personal hearing thresholds. Once the test is completed, you can read the audiogram as follows:
Every sound located above the markers will be inaudible to you. The *Overlay* button gives you an
idea of what these sounds could be.

## Welcome!

My name is [Stéphane Pigeon][1], I am an audio engineer and professional sound designer. I have been
looking for a convenient and reliable way to assess my hearing, online. As I couldn't find any
online test that was able to evaluate one's hearing thresholds, I designed my own test, and put it
online. Measuring hearing thresholds requires calibrated equipment. Therefore, most audiologists
will tell you that such a test can not be put online, and just run on any computer. Well, yes, it
can. Here I show how it is done. I do claim the intellectual property related to the hand rubbing
calibration trick. The original test appeared on [AudioCheck][2] in July 2012. HearingTest.online
offers an improved version of my original test, with upgraded test tones and a better user
interface.

Enjoy!

Stéphane

## **Advanced Diagnostic Hearing Evaluations –** Look at the Why Behind the What

retail store. But in the same way that you wouldn’t trust the internet or a retail employee to make

hearing loss and need hearing aids,** diagnostic hearing evaluations given by our hearing doctors
look much deeper to determine why you may be experiencing hearing challenges to solve the core
problem.

challenge and explore alternative options.

[Learn More][31]

medically-recommended way to address this challenge is to visit a Doctor of Audiology** to have your
ears professionally cleaned.

Our hearing doctors utilize the latest technology to ensure that removing earwax is **quick and
pain-free.** You will walk away with your ears feeling clean and clear at last!

## Hearing Assessment

Our goal is to treat your hearing needs with care and modern hearing assessment facilities. We use
clinical testing to make sure what is causing hearing loss. With these tests, we can assess your
progress, form a treatment plan, and evaluate the effectiveness of treatment, regardless of the
intervention options we pursue. We provide following hearing assessment services using state of the
art technology and modern techniques.

[ ][160]

### [PTA TEST][161]

Pure Tone Audiometry (PTA) is a hearing test performed on the ears by measuring the smallest
amplitude of sound waves in the absolute-tone test. This test can be performed with a microphone or
without. It is the most accurate way to determine when the correct amount of hearing aids will be
suitable for an individual. IHC perform PTA test at affordable rates in Pakistan.

[ ][162]

### [Tympanometry ][163]

Tympanometry is a clinical test measuring the tympanic layer, the soft tissue surrounding the
eardrum. Tympanometry is the standard screening test used by audiologists to assess whether there is
any hearing loss. Tympanometry is a test that measures the level of sound heard by the ears,
specifically by measuring the loudness of sounds.

[ ][164]

### [ASSR TEST][165]

The ASSR is a hearing test that measures the patient’s ability to maintain sound in quiet, steady
tones. The sound is played through a speaker so that the patient can hear it clearly, and then their
responses are recorded. Children who are too young for conventional audiometric testing can evaluate
their hearing using the objective test known as Auditory Steady State Response (ASSR).

## Hearing Care Solutions

Islamabad Hearing Center (IHC) (Pvt.) Ltd. is Pakistan’s most advanced audiology network and digital
hearing aid company, providing premium audiological services throughout Pakistan. For the first time
in Pakistan, we are proud to provide a diverse range of audiological services under one roof. Our
work process is divided into four departments: comprehensive audiological checkups, medication
surgeries, digital hearing aids (including wholesale supply in hospitals, government departments,
and local hearing centers in Pakistan), backup support warranty centers for hearing aids, and
research centers with customized solutions.

We take pride in offering qualified services for hearing aids from well-known brands such as Signia,
Phonak, Digital Soundlink, Widex, Oticon, Bernafon, Rexton, Starkey, Unitorn, and Resound. Our team
of specialized hearing professionals, which includes ENT specialists, certified audiologists,
internationally trained engineers, and technology experts, enables us to provide our services
throughout Pakistan. We have been providing comprehensive hearing services to the hearing community
since 2009. Let’s discuss how we can improve your hearing!

[ Contact Us ][159]

## Hearing Assessment

Our goal is to treat your hearing needs with care and modern hearing assessment facilities. We use
clinical testing to make sure what is causing hearing loss. With these tests, we can assess your
progress, form a treatment plan, and evaluate the effectiveness of treatment, regardless of the
intervention options we pursue. We provide following hearing assessment services using state of the
art technology and modern techniques.

[ ][160]

### [PTA TEST][161]

Pure Tone Audiometry (PTA) is a hearing test performed on the ears by measuring the smallest
amplitude of sound waves in the absolute-tone test. This test can be performed with a microphone or
without. It is the most accurate way to determine when the correct amount of hearing aids will be
suitable for an individual. IHC perform PTA test at affordable rates in Pakistan.

[ ][162]

### [Tympanometry ][163]

Tympanometry is a clinical test measuring the tympanic layer, the soft tissue surrounding the
eardrum. Tympanometry is the standard screening test used by audiologists to assess whether there is
any hearing loss. Tympanometry is a test that measures the level of sound heard by the ears,
specifically by measuring the loudness of sounds.

[ ][164]

### [ASSR TEST][165]

The ASSR is a hearing test that measures the patient’s ability to maintain sound in quiet, steady
tones. The sound is played through a speaker so that the patient can hear it clearly, and then their
responses are recorded. Children who are too young for conventional audiometric testing can evaluate
their hearing using the objective test known as Auditory Steady State Response (ASSR).

The International Humanitarian Hearing Aid Purchasing Program has its primary goal of creating
accessibility to hearing aids for humanitarians who support hearing health care across the globe in
low resource settings.  These devices are provided to qualified Humanitarian Programs and Not For
Profit Organizations with long-term relationships to their clients in the countries being served.
IHHAPP is currently administered by Mayflower Medical Outreach (a not for profit NGO) and has the
support of the Coalition for Global Hearing Health.  IHHAPP has a Memorandum of Understanding with
the Rotarians for Hearing RAG (Rotarian Action Group).  IHHAPP looks forward to working with you
towards expanding hearing aid access.  At this time, IHHAPP members span the globe providing
services in the following countries:  Brazil, Cambodia, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Malawi,
Mexico, Nicaragua, Papua New Guinea, Peru, the Philippines, Romania, Tanzania, Uzbekistan and
Zimbabwe.

[Mayflower Medical Outreach][11]

[Coalition for Global Hearing Health][12]


IHHAPP uses the United Nations Human Development Index (HDI) to determine country eligibility.  HDI
is a composite statistic of life expectancy, education and per capita income indicators which are
used to rank countries into four tiers of human development.  Countries ranked as low, medium and
high are eligible for participation in the IHHAPP program.  Countries ranked as very high are not
eligible.

[Human Development Index][13]

 

According to the World Health Organization (WHO), over 430 million people have disabling hearing
impairment.  The vast majority of these individuals live in resource poor countries, where access to
audiology services is limited.  There is an estimated need for 7 million hearing aids in developing
countries yet fewer than 1 million people actually have use of this technology.  While the reasons
for the paucity of hearing aid fittings are complex, one of the major barriers to providing hearing
aids has been their high cost. 

[World Health Organization][14]


Many individuals and humanitarian organizations work to address this unmet need of providing hearing
aid services to low resource environments.  The IHHAPP was created to support these programs by
making high quality low cost hearing aids available to qualified members. The devices are not to be
sold for profit or to compete with existing hearing aid distribution networks.  Potential applicants
complete an application and provide a signed letter of agreement and reference letters.

### The IHHAPP team looks forward to working with you to enhance access to hearing care worldwide.

[20a77a33-e3b1-48fd-8a8e-cc2ee112ede5.jpg]

The hearing aids offered through the IHHAPP are new, low-cost digital behind the ear (BTE) hearing
aids that can be adjusted via screw set potentiometers or are software based.  Two manufacturers’
hearing aids are available and hearing losses ranging from mild to profound can be accommodated. 
All hearing aids include a presentation case and user guides.  Programming guides are available to
support optimized fittings.  Please refer to the Products Section for specifics on each
manufacturers’ product line.


## Please note that the  International Humanitarian Hearing Aid Purchasing Program (IHHAPP) services
## humanitarian audiologists and organizations and
## is not able to fulfill individual requests for hearing aids.

low resource settings.  These devices are provided to qualified Humanitarian Programs and Not For
Profit Organizations with long-term relationships to their clients in the countries being served.
IHHAPP is currently administered by Mayflower Medical Outreach (a not for profit NGO) and has the
support of the Coalition for Global Hearing Health.  IHHAPP has a Memorandum of Understanding with
the Rotarians for Hearing RAG (Rotarian Action Group).  IHHAPP looks forward to working with you
towards expanding hearing aid access.  At this time, IHHAPP members span the globe providing
services in the following countries:  Brazil, Cambodia, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Malawi,
Mexico, Nicaragua, Papua New Guinea, Peru, the Philippines, Romania, Tanzania, Uzbekistan and
Zimbabwe.

[Mayflower Medical Outreach][11]

[Coalition for Global Hearing Health][12]


IHHAPP uses the United Nations Human Development Index (HDI) to determine country eligibility.  HDI
is a composite statistic of life expectancy, education and per capita income indicators which are
used to rank countries into four tiers of human development.  Countries ranked as low, medium and
high are eligible for participation in the IHHAPP program.  Countries ranked as very high are not
eligible.

[Human Development Index][13]

 

According to the World Health Organization (WHO), over 430 million people have disabling hearing
impairment.  The vast majority of these individuals live in resource poor countries, where access to
audiology services is limited.  There is an estimated need for 7 million hearing aids in developing
countries yet fewer than 1 million people actually have use of this technology.  While the reasons
for the paucity of hearing aid fittings are complex, one of the major barriers to providing hearing
aids has been their high cost. 

[World Health Organization][14]


Many individuals and humanitarian organizations work to address this unmet need of providing hearing
aid services to low resource environments.  The IHHAPP was created to support these programs by
making high quality low cost hearing aids available to qualified members. The devices are not to be
sold for profit or to compete with existing hearing aid distribution networks.  Potential applicants
complete an application and provide a signed letter of agreement and reference letters.

  The Center is the largest program of its kind embedded within a healthcare system in the U.S.

# welcome to Nevada Ear + Sinus Institute

You and your family can expect the best care from our expert physicians and staff at Nevada Ear +
Sinus Institute, the premier health care provider in the greater Las Vegas area. We’re happy to help
treat a variety of ear, nose and throat disorders.

## Sinus pressure got you down?

Sinusitis is the number one reported chronic condition in the United States, affecting an estimated
37 million Americans. Whether you’re experiencing congestion, pressure or other issues, let our
experts help you with treatment options such as sinus surgery and balloon sinuplasty.

[EXPLORE BALLOON SINUPLASTY][108]

## Dreading spring due to allergies?

Our ENT physicians are trained in the diagnosis, treatment and management of allergies. We offer
allergy testing and proven treatment plans to ease your seasonal or year-round suffering.

[SEEK ALLERGY RELIEF][109]

## Having trouble hearing?

Having a hard time hearing other people or notice that you don’t enjoy certain activities as much as
you used to? Hearing loss affects millions of Americans regardless of age. Whether you’re in need of
a hearing test, cochlear implants or hearing surgery, our experts can help. We also treat conditions
such as eustachian tube dysfunction, perforated eardrums and more.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT HEARING][110]

## What is an ENT?

Known more commonly as an ear, nose and throat (ENT) doctor, an otolaryngologist can help you with a
variety of symptoms related to any disorder of the head and neck. Whether you’re dealing with an ear
infection, sinus pressure or hoarseness, let our experts help you on your journey toward wellness.

[EXPLORE YOUR OPTIONS][111]

# welcome to Nevada Ear + Sinus Institute

You and your family can expect the best care from our expert physicians and staff at Nevada Ear +
Sinus Institute, the premier health care provider in the greater Las Vegas area. We’re happy to help
treat a variety of ear, nose and throat disorders.

## Sinus pressure got you down?

Sinusitis is the number one reported chronic condition in the United States, affecting an estimated
37 million Americans. Whether you’re experiencing congestion, pressure or other issues, let our
experts help you with treatment options such as sinus surgery and balloon sinuplasty.

[EXPLORE BALLOON SINUPLASTY][108]

## Dreading spring due to allergies?

Our ENT physicians are trained in the diagnosis, treatment and management of allergies. We offer
allergy testing and proven treatment plans to ease your seasonal or year-round suffering.

[SEEK ALLERGY RELIEF][109]

## Having trouble hearing?

Having a hard time hearing other people or notice that you don’t enjoy certain activities as much as
you used to? Hearing loss affects millions of Americans regardless of age. Whether you’re in need of
a hearing test, cochlear implants or hearing surgery, our experts can help. We also treat conditions
such as eustachian tube dysfunction, perforated eardrums and more.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT HEARING][110]

## What is an ENT?

Known more commonly as an ear, nose and throat (ENT) doctor, an otolaryngologist can help you with a
variety of symptoms related to any disorder of the head and neck. Whether you’re dealing with an ear
infection, sinus pressure or hoarseness, let our experts help you on your journey toward wellness.

[EXPLORE YOUR OPTIONS][111]

At Northwest Hearing + Tinnitus, our passion is helping people overcome problems with their hearing.
Whether it’s ringing in your ears ([tinnitus][105]), or [struggling to hear][106], [earwax
buildup][107], or any other ear related problem, we’re here to help. [Our doctors][108] are friendly
and professional expert audiologists that love to educate and help you. We have four
[audiology][109] locations to serve you: [Seattle][110], [Olympia][111], [Bremerton][112], and [Gig
Harbor][113].

## Patient Resources & Education FAQs

1. What is the connection, if any, between hearing and brain health?
In both the Lancet Health study by Lin and a study by the Alzheimer’s Association, hearing loss can
lead to a more rapid cognitive decline.
2. What forms of insurance are accepted?
Ohio Audiology Associates is credentialed with most insurance carriers for both commercial and
Medicare policies. While most people do not have hearing coverage, it is worth looking into specific

3. What are Hearing Aid Benefits with Insurance?

## About Us

In 2013, ProChek1 Vision X was born from a powerful vision – to protect those who protect us. As
inspections across ndustries grew more complex and hazardous, I recognized a critical need:
safeguarding inspectors in real-time, on the job. I saw beyond traditional tools – imagining smart
safety glasses that could serve as both shield and guide. From that vision,
I began designing a solution that would blend protection with precision – leveraging advanced
optics, real-time data, and intelligent systems to enhance safety, reduce risks,
and empower inspectors in the field. ProChek1 Vision X isn’t just about eyewear – it’s about
vision-driven innovation, protecting lives, and reshaping how the world sees safety.

## About Us

## For Individuals with Hearing Impairment

Vision X glasses provide **real-time visual and sensory assistance** to those who are deaf or hard
of hearing:

## 1

#### Live Speech-to-Text Transcription
1. Converts spoken language into **real-time captions** displayed on the AR lens, allowing users to
   follow conversations effortlessly.
2. Supports multiple languages and **AI-driven noise filtering** to ensure clarity in noisy
   environments.

## 2

#### Sign Language Recognition & Translation
1. The glasses use **AI-powered sign language recognition** to interpret **American Sign Language
   (ASL)** and other sign languages, converting them into **text or synthesized speech** for hearing
   individuals.

## 3

#### Situational Awareness Enhancements
1. Uses **360-degree motion detection and alerts** to notify users of approaching vehicles, alarms,
   or emergency situations through **vibrational feedback or visual signals.**
2. Enhances safety in **workplaces, construction sites, and public spaces.**

 

## 4

#### Integration with Smart Devices & Communication Platforms
1. Syncs with **smartphones, hearing aids, and assistive apps** for seamless communication via
   **text messages, AI-powered voice assistants, and AR-based calls.**
2. Can be used in **emergency response scenarios** where the user needs **instant visual
   communication.**

## For Individuals with Vision Impairment

Vision X glasses employ **AI-powered vision assistance** to help individuals with **low vision or
blindness** by enhancing **spatial awareness, object recognition, and navigation:**

### 01

### AI-Enhanced Object & Text Recognition
* The glasses use **computer vision **to **identify objects, people, and obstacles**, providing
  real-time **audio descriptions** to assist users.
* Reads signs, labels, menus, and other **printed/digital text** using **OCR (Optical Character
  Recognition) **and converts it into **audio output.**

### Voice-Guided Navigation & Spatial Awareness
* Provides **real-time indoor and outdoor navigation** via **GPS-based guidance** and **LiDAR-based
  mapping** to help users **avoid obstacles and locate destinations.**
* Uses **haptic (vibrational) feedback** to **warn users of hazards** like stairs, curbs, or moving
  objects.

### 02

### 03

### Facial & Emotion Recognition for Social Interactions
* Identifies people in the user’s field of view and **provides cues about their facial expressions**
  to aid in social interactions.
* Can be paired with a **voice assistant** that whispers the identified **names or emotions**
  discreetly through bone-conduction audio.

### Enhanced Contrast & Magnification for Low Vision
* Adjustable **contrast enhancement, zoom, and color filters** allow users with **partial vision
  loss** to better perceive their surroundings.
* AR overlays can provide **highlighted outlines** of objects for improved clarity.

### 04

## Conclusion

ProChek1 Vision X glasses are designed to be a multi-functional assistive technology, empowering
individuals with hearing and vision impairments to communicate more effectively, navigate safely,
and work in high-risk environments with greater confidence. By integrating AI, AR, computer vision,
and smart communication tools, Vision X enhances accessibility and independence for users across
industries and daily life.

which are smaller and more intelligent than ever.

With severe to profound hearing loss, environments with background noise are especially challenging.
But what if you could gain even more improvements without compromising on anything? Introducing
ReSound Enzo™ IA.

[Explore ReSound Enzo IA][63]

ReSound Savi™ refines and combines our best-in-class technologies with our advanced features, giving
you clear sound, small designs, a natural fit and future-proof connectivity.

[Explore ReSound Savi][64]

Life is so much more enjoyable when you can hear what’s going on around you. Our hearing aids can
help you get back the life you remember.

of nature. After finding Custom made by ReSound hearing aids she can once again recognize twenty
different birds from their song. Find out more about the benefits Custom made by ReSound could bring
to you.

# [Noise Pollution: The Global Threat to Hearing Health][11]

[Admin][12] 18th July 2026

[Environment & Sustainability][13] [Hearing Safety][14]

Last Updated on 10/05/2025 by [Admin][15]

## In-Depth Analysis of Noise Pollution and Its Effects on Hearing

### Understanding Noise Pollution: Definitions and Key Sources

Noise pollution represents a serious and widespread environmental issue, defined by the presence of
excessive sound levels from a variety of sources that adversely affect **hearing health** globally.
This phenomenon permeates our daily lives across different environments, from the bustling activity
of urban centres to the relative calm of suburban areas. Major contributors to noise pollution
include **traffic noise**, **industrial operations**, **construction work**, loud music, and even
natural sounds that become amplified due to human activity. As urbanisation accelerates, this
environmental stressor becomes increasingly prominent, impacting both developed and developing
regions. The ubiquity of noise pollution underscores its importance for **health professionals**,
**urban planners**, and the general public.

Research indicates that the predominant sources of noise pollution are **road traffic**, **rail
systems**, and **air traffic**. the noise generated by entertainment venues and recreational
activities should not be overlooked. Events such as **concerts**, **nightclubs**, and **[sports
events][16]** can produce significant noise levels, posing immediate and long-term risks to hearing
health. As urban populations grow, the challenge of managing noise pollution becomes more complex.
Increasing demands for efficient transportation and entertainment options create a perfect storm for
auditory damage. it is essential to address these sources through community education and engagement
to foster greater awareness of noise pollution.

### Measuring Noise Levels Accurately for Greater Awareness

To fully grasp the harmful effects of noise pollution on hearing, accurate measurement of noise
levels is crucial. Noise is quantified using the **decibel (dB)** scale, which measures sound
intensity. Prolonged exposure to sound levels exceeding 85 dB is widely accepted as detrimental to
hearing health. This threshold is particularly concerning since common sources—such as heavy
traffic, construction sites, and loud music—often exceed this limit in urban settings. For example,
a standard motorcycle can produce sound levels of 95 dB, while a rock concert can peak at a
staggering 120 dB, significantly endangering attendees’ hearing.

Understanding decibel measurements is essential for promoting public awareness and developing
effective policies. These measurements help pinpoint environments where sound levels surpass safe
limits, enabling targeted interventions. Various countries have established guidelines aimed at
maintaining acceptable noise levels in public spaces and workplaces. The **World Health Organization
(WHO)** recommends that nighttime noise levels remain below 40 dB to foster healthy sleep,
underscoring the global consensus on the necessity of managing sound exposure.

Advancements in technology have facilitated continuous noise monitoring, empowering communities to
track their acoustic environments in real-time. Such systems not only help individuals identify when
they are in high-noise areas but also equip advocacy groups with the tools to push for regulatory
changes. By leveraging noise measurement technologies, communities worldwide can champion healthier
living conditions and mitigate the negative impacts of sound pollution.

### Common Scenarios of Exposure to Noise Pollution

Everyday environments greatly influence how noise pollution affects hearing health. Traffic is a
primary source, with urban dwellers frequently subjected to the constant din of vehicles. Cities
like **Tokyo**, **New York**, and **Mumbai** exemplify this issue, where the relentless sounds of
car horns, sirens, and construction create a continuous auditory backdrop. Individuals commuting in
these vibrant cities often navigate soundscapes that reach hazardous decibel levels, heightening
their risk of hearing impairment.

The workplace also plays a significant role in exposure scenarios. Industries such as
**[manufacturing][17]** and **construction** often involve high-decibel machinery that poses
considerable auditory stress. Workers in these settings frequently face challenges due to inadequate
protective measures against noise. For instance, construction sites may operate equipment that
exceeds 90 dB, necessitating effective hearing conservation programs to protect employees from
permanent hearing loss.
